info.description:
REST API for managing Nuclei vulnerability scans.
The service validates every target against a configurable scope allowlist,
exposes scan profiles (built-in and custom), and stores tasks that bind a
target to a profile. It is the control plane for a planned worker that
executes Nuclei and stores runs and findings.
info.title: scanner-manager API

get.description: Returns all scan profiles ordered by id, including the seeded built-in profiles.

post.description: Creates a custom profile. Zero-valued numeric fields are filled with defaults before validation.

get.description: Returns a single profile by id.

put.description: Full replacement of a custom profile by id. Built-in profiles are read-only and return 409.

delete.description: Deletes a custom profile by id. Built-in profiles and profiles referenced by tasks return 409.

409.description: Built-in profile or profile in use

get.description: Returns runs ordered by id (newest first). Optionally filter by task_id and/or status.
Returns a single run by id, including timing and finding counters.
Returns a UTF-8 page of the run's supervisor log starting at a byte offset. Pass next_offset back to tail.

Downloads the raw Nuclei JSONL results for a run as application/x-ndjson. Use ?format=pdf to get a PDF report instead. The results of the web pass and of the optional network pass are merged; pass "pass=web" or "pass=network" to download only one of them. Returns 204 if the run produced no findings.

200.description: Newline-delimited JSON results or PDF report

get.description: Generates and downloads a PDF report of the run's Nuclei findings (web + network passes merged). Returns 204 if the run produced no findings.

post.description: Cancels a queued run, or asks the worker to stop a running run. Stopping a running run is asynchronous.

202.description: Stop requested for a running run

409.description: Run already finished or is not active on this instance

get.description: Returns all scope allowlist entries ordered by id. An empty allowlist makes the target check fail-closed.

post.description: Adds a domain, CIDR or IP to the allowlist. Values are normalized and validated.

delete.description: Removes a scope entry by id.

get.description: Returns all targets ordered by id.

post.description: Creates a target after validating it and enforcing the scope allowlist on every host. Rejects out-of-scope hosts with 422.

422.description: One or more hosts are outside the allowed scope

get.description: Returns a single target by id.

put.description: Full replacement of a target by id. The new host list is re-validated against the scope allowlist.

422.description: One or more hosts are outside the allowed scope

delete.description: Deletes a target by id. Returns 409 when one or more tasks reference it.

409.description: Target is used by one or more tasks

post.description: Triggers a new port/service discovery run in the background. Returns 202.

get.description: Returns all discovered ports/services for a target.
get.summary: List discovered endpoints for a target

get.description: Returns all tasks ordered by id.

post.description: Creates a task binding a target to a profile. Both must already exist.

get.description: Returns a single task by id.

put.description: Full replacement of a task by id. The referenced target and profile must exist.

delete.description: Deletes a task by id. Returns 409 when the task has an active (queued or running) run.

post.description: Validates the task's target/profile against the scope, freezes a config snapshot and queues a run. The worker picks it up and executes Nuclei.
post.summary: Queue a run for a task

400.description: Task not found, or its target is out of scope

409.description: Task already has an active run
